LanguageData.VoidAwake_WorldClockTipControls: Left-drag to move.\nRight-click to jump to the void erosion origin.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_JumpOriginMissing: The erosion origin does not exist yet.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_WorldClockFlavor_0: The void still sleeps. Prepare to flee—or to stand against it.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_WorldClockFlavor_1: Void erosion has begun. Act before it is too late.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_WorldClockFlavor_4: The erosion spreads without fail. Each night, the beasts' voices twist a little more.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_WorldClockFlavor_7: The void is no longer rumor. Settlements vanish, roads break, and the sky changes color.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_WorldClockFlavor_10: Most of the world has been swallowed. What land remains holds its breath in the needle's shadow.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_WorldClockFlavor_12: The world has fallen to the void.
